import random
random.seed(7)
sample = [float(x) for x in open("sample.txt")]
n = len(sample)
means = sorted(
    sum(random.choices(sample, k=n)) / n
    for _ in range(10_000)
)
lo, hi = means[249], means[9749]
print(f"95% CI: [{lo:.2f}, {hi:.2f}]")
with open("ci.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(f"{lo:.4f} {hi:.4f}")
EOF
